_comment: Phase 4d Task 1: provenance for the two independent real 2015 production weight-pack/config tuples closing the Phase-0a packer/adim deferral (no independent legacy golden pack was known to exist at Phase 0a time -- see CLAUDE.md 'Phase 0a status').
